name: default
about: The shipped starting map (scripts/seed_worldmap.py). Repaint it in the tuner's World Map tab. Tier A: seed-independent.

sites.about: The selftest harness region: no tree trunks or crowns, no tarns, no cover. Keeps every fixture column (60..150 on the x==z diagonal) and the test tarn at (420,420) on the ground the gates were written against.
